name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted family planner with tasks, calendar, budget, meals and shopping lists, backed by an encrypted SQLite database on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: The first visitor creates the admin account in the browser. Open the app right after deployment to claim it.
DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY encrypts the database and its backups and cannot be changed on an existing database. Keep a copy of it outside the server, or backups cannot be opened.
